name: Dokuzetsu Cool na Imouto o Seiteki ni Kawaigaru! ~Nii-san no Hentai, Dohentai! Sekinin Totte Haramasete yo ne!~
original_name: 毒舌クールな妹を性的に可愛がる！～兄さんの変態、ド変態！責任とって孕ませてよね！～
source:
My little stepsister is perfect in every way: scholastic, athletic, and a great homekeeper. She's also cool and dismissive and brazenly self-interested... I can't help having fantasies about her... fantasies that I never thought would come true until I saw her in her bedroom. She was huffing a pair of my dirty pants!
